{{Quote|If Rogun goes down, as far as anyone's concerned, I did it single-handedly. With a spoon.''"<br />"''Blindfolded and after four shots of Corellian whiskey. Of course.|The Voidhound and Darmas Pollaran|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Kneesaa_spoon.jpg|thumb|right|[[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka]] with a spoon.]]
A '''spoon''' was a utensil that could be used by sapient beings to consume [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]]. It also served the purpose of stirring a drink.<ref name="Shrieks">{{Ewoks|Home Is Where the Shrieks Are}}</ref> [[High General|General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Kenobi]] was known to have used a spoon to stir his [[Tarine tea/Legends|tarine tea]] while he talked with [[General/Legends|General]] [[Whorm Loathsom/Legends|Whorm Loathsom]] during the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]].<ref name="TCW film">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref> [[0 BBY/Legends|Twenty-two years later]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] along with [[Owen Lars/Legends|Owen]] and [[Beru Whitesun Lars/Legends|Beru Lars]] had a meal where spoons were used to eat with.<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> In this same year, Kenobi compared [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] little perception of [[The Force/Legends|the Force's]] power with a spoon's perception of the taste of food.<ref name="SW4">[[Star Wars (1977) 4|''Star Wars'' (1977) 4]]</ref>
In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], Luke Skywalker was known to have once again used a spoon when eating food prepared by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]].<ref name="ESB">{{Film|V}}</ref>
